name: ImageMaid
description: Clean up images in a Plex Media Server. Formerly Plex Image Cleanup. Part of the Kometa suite.
requires: Container requires a .env file in the Config Path directory. See documentation for details: https://github.com/Kometa-Team/ImageMaid?tab=readme-ov-file#example-env-file

paths.name: Plex Path
paths.description: Path to root Plex directory (typically Library/Application Support/Plex Media Server, should contain a Plug-in Support directory)

paths.name: Config Path
paths.description: Path to config directory containing .env file
